programs.description: An ambitious young woman moves to Chandigarh to pursue higher education and a better future. Her life takes a difficult turn when she falls into the wrong company and faces new challenges.
Bringing the best in cinema.
A middle-class student is hired by a Delhi socialite to act as her boyfriend. However, the line between their false relationship and genuine emotion begins to blur as real feelings develop.
Bringing the best in cinema.
A man who loves his mother tongue, Punjabi, teaches the language in school. However, his students' behaviour compel him to resign.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Four rebellious young women open fire on a group of boys at Punjab University, determined to challenge the system. But what pushed them to take such a drastic step?
Cheekh
When Jeet goes missing during the war, his lover Simmi becomes desperate for answers.
Bringing the best in cinema.
A young woman disappears, whose father, a dedicated social activist and small printing business owner, is ruthlessly murdered.
Rabaabi struggles against the pain of displacement from his native land and the adversities of a new neighbourhood after relocating to Pakistan with his family during the partition of 1947.
When the employees of an organisation desperately attempt to impress their newly appointed boss, it leads to the creation of several misunderstandings and confusion.
Four candidates competing in the sarpanch election go through a series of hilarious situations as they try to lure villagers into voting for them.
Bringing the best in cinema.

2022;Cast:Zubeen Garg, Barshrani Bishaya, Tapan Das, Siddhartha Sharma. Two friends took two very different paths in life. One rose to be the Chief Minister of State, while the other ended up as an Editor-in-Chief of a news agency. Years apart, as fate would have it, their paths get intertwined.
Aditya searches for his childhood sweetheart, Sana, after ten years of separation. However, he only has one final address left to investigate in his attempt to locate her.
Baroohaan
When Pakhar and Surjit, both of whom had traumatic childhoods, wed, their married life went as unexpectedly as their pasts did.
Two sisters, Dimple and Pari, love each other and always have each other's back. However, when a man enters their life, their relationship is tested.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Mehtaab Singh is given the task of informing the family of his comrade about the latter's demise. Complications arise when he is forced to hide the truth and falls in love with his comrade's widow.
Ujjagar Singh, a widower with three children, is admitted to the hospital and learns that his sons are praying for his death from the Grim Reaper.
